{{Nihongo|'''Tsuda Kōji'''|津田 耕治||1934-2023}} was a Japanese singer-songwriter known for his involvement in modern [[enka]]. His first name is sometimes spelled {{Nihongo|'''Kōji'''|耕次|}}.

==Early life==
Tsuda was born in 1934 in the city of Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture under his real name {{Nihongo|'''Sakaida Teruyoshi'''|坂井田 照義|}}. He graduated from the [[Gifu Technical High School]] where he was the leader of an [[ōendan]] team.<ref>{{cite web |title=「甲子園原頭」あれから数十年III |url=https://blog.goo.ne.jp/narazugaoka/e/d87ea5149a617008aa2fbf65c4eff158 |website=岐阜工業高校同窓会 Gifu Technical High School Alumni Association |access-date=16 February 2022 |language=ja}}</ref>

== Music career ==
In [[Osaka]], he studied music under the [[naniwabushi]] master {{ill|Hirosawa Kikuharu II|ja|広沢菊春#2代目}} (1914-1964) and thence became involved in enka.<ref>{{cite web |title=津田耕治ベスト「河内遊侠伝」 (日本クラウン創立55周年記念企画) Kawachi Yūkyōden - The Best of Tsuda Kōji (Nippon Crown 55th Anniversary Project) |url=http://elsurrecords.com/%E6%B4%A5%E7%94%B0%E8%80%95%E6%B2%BB%E3%83%99%E3%82%B9%E3%83%88%E3%80%8C%E6%B2%B3%E5%86%85%E9%81%8A%E4%BE%A0%E4%BC%9D%E3%80%8D-%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E3%82%AF%E3%83%A9%E3%82%A6%E3%83%B3%E5%89%B5%E7%AB%8B/26/01/2018/ |website=El Sur Records |publisher=Nippon Crown Co., Ltd. |access-date=6 February 2022 |language=ja}}</ref> Tsuda's style came to be influenced by [[Kawachi ondo]].

In 1967, he performed the eponymous theme song to the [[yakuza film]] {{ill|Kawachi Yūkyōden|ja|河内遊侠伝}} written by {{ill|Hoshino Tetsurō|ja|星野哲郎}}.<ref>{{cite web |title=河内遊侠伝 Kawachi Yūkyōden |url=http://www.kinenote.com/main/public/cinema/detail.aspx?cinema_id=22305 |website=KineNote |access-date=6 February 2022 |language=ja}}</ref> After 1970, Tsuda studied the music of [[Soeda Azenbō]] and made a number of his own recordings of Azenbō's songs.

== Death ==
Tsuda died of malignant [[lymphoma]] on April 30, 2023.<ref name=Jiji/>

==Selected works==

* {{Nihongo|''Lyrical Travelogue of the Enka Life''|演歌人生うた紀行}} (1997, [[Compact disc|CD]], Crown Records CRCN-48501)
